decisions.reason: Report grounds the attempt-1 failure in ls-remote-tags.txt (v0.9.1 jumps to v0.9.7, v0.9.5 absent) and traces the cause to sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main with no tag pushes, explicitly ruling out network, consumer typo, or missing package explanations.

Uses dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) and compat-table.md to explain v0.9.7 is forward-targeted at 0.1.2-alpha.1 and imports the useConversation seat absent on the older runtime, noting install success and restarts do not establish API compatibility.

Correctly selects v0.9.3 via the rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note and gives a pin command, but asserts 'v0.9.3 exists on the mirror', contradicting ls-remote-tags.txt (only v0.9.0/v0.9.1/v0.9.7 listed) and presents the absent tag as immediately installable with no conditional commit alternative.

Proposes explicit git push <remote> --tags (or --follow-tags) to every mirror (origin, public, mirror2) grounded in the branch-only sync script, plus ls-remote --tags verification of each documented tag per mirror.

Provides a README routing matrix (rc.x to v0.9.3, alpha.1 to v0.9.7) plus a manifest version-range check so installs fail early, but routes '0.1.2-alpha.1+' to v0.9.7, generalizing support to untested future alpha releases, which the requirement forbids.
